name: Learning Commons Knowledge Graph
summary: U.S. academic standards, learning components, learning progressions and misconception data from several publishers, linked in one graph with a shared schema.

license.note: Code MIT. Data is licensed dataset by dataset: the open ones are CC BY 4.0 or CC0, and state standards carry each state's own terms. IM v.360 instructional and assessment materials, OpenSciEd and one more dataset are gated: not openly licensed, and only with the publisher's approval. Its terms of use rule out high-stakes decisions such as grading or placement.

access_note: The open datasets download as JSONL (nodes.jsonl and relationships.jsonl). The REST API and the MCP server, both in early access, need a Learning Commons API key.
cite: Learning Commons Knowledge Graph, https://github.com/learning-commons-org/knowledge-graph (release v1.16.0, 2026-10-21). Each dataset carries its own attribution statement.

fits.how: A standard, with its learning components, joins the AI's instructions on every turn through an activity's teaching settings. Choosing a standard needs Learning Commons' API.
